authority: User $implement request; approved CW-15/C-D52; independent duplicate takeover generation finding
objective: Attribute a duplicate takeover invocation's newer fence generation to the existing takeover without replay, so its later valid handoff can reopen exactly that newest generation.
required_changes: When request_takeover has already synchronously created a newer fence generation and then observes the same durable takeover_requested state, update the coordinator's active takeover generation to that new value before returning LifecycleHeld. Do not call the external control port or change the durable journal.

Preserve concurrency: a duplicate that wins the lifecycle lock before handoff is included in that handoff's captured generation; a request that races after handoff capture continues to prevent the older reopen and becomes its own durable takeover after acquiring the lock.

Do not loosen stale session/process/owner checks, claim semantics, normal failure closure or no-replay. Add/retain deterministic tests for duplicate-before-handoff, duplicate-vs-handoff both orders, durable journal unchanged on duplicate, external call count zero, and eventual automatic resume only after the valid handoff.
constraints: Minimal duplicate-generation correction only. No other production/docs/workflow/PLAN/state, G3/pause changes, external/scripted OMP, reboot, dependency install, delegation, commit, publish, deploy or Docker. Use apply_patch and non-live checks only.
report: Return candidate_ready/needs_reroute; generation/durable/external/action counts for duplicate and racing schedules; test totals/hashes/scope/residue/pending.
